description: This Java source file defines a final class DeviceRegistryHttpClient that provides methods to manage tenants, devices, credentials, and related resources via HTTP in the context of the Eclipse Hono project. It includes methods for adding, retrieving, updating, and deleting tenants and devices, as well as managing credentials of various types. The class leverages Vert.x for asynchronous HTTP communication and includes helper methods for common operations like registering devices with passwords, client certificates, or pre-shared keys.

classes.name: DeviceRegistryHttpClient
classes.description: A client for accessing the Device Registry's HTTP resources for Device Registration, Credentials, and Tenant API. It provides asynchronous methods to manage tenants, devices, and credentials through HTTP operations using Vert.x.

methods.name: addTenant
methods.description: Adds configuration information for a tenant, expecting HTTP 201 Created by default.

methods.name: getTenant
methods.description: Retrieves configuration information for a tenant, expecting HTTP 200 OK.

methods.name: updateTenant
methods.description: Updates configuration information for a tenant.

methods.name: removeTenant
methods.description: Removes configuration information for a tenant.

methods.name: registerDevice
methods.description: Adds registration information for a device, with overloads for default behavior and expected status codes.

methods.name: getRegistrationInfo
methods.description: Retrieves registration information for a specific device.

methods.name: deregisterDevice
methods.description: Removes registration information for a device.

methods.name: addCredentials
methods.description: Adds credentials for a device, supporting different credential types and responses.

methods.name: getCredentials
methods.description: Retrieves all credentials for a device.

methods.name: getCredentials
methods.description: Retrieves specific credentials of a certain type for a device.

methods.name: updateCredentials
methods.description: Updates credentials of a specific type for a device, with overloads for raw payload.

methods.name: updateCredentialsWithVersion
methods.description: Updates credentials with version matching for concurrency control.

methods.name: addDeviceForTenant
methods.description: Creates a tenant and adds a device with specified credentials (password, certificate, or PSK).

methods.name: addDeviceToTenant
methods.description: Adds a device with a password to an existing tenant.

methods.name: addDeviceToTenant
methods.description: Adds a device with specified data and password to an existing tenant.

methods.name: addDeviceForTenant
methods.description: Creates a tenant and adds a device with a client certificate.

methods.name: addPskDeviceForTenant
methods.description: Creates a tenant and adds a device with a PSK credential.

methods.name: addPskDeviceToTenant
methods.description: Adds a device with a PSK credential to an existing tenant.
